_comment: Placement of Caves of Qud's modern main-menu elements, measured from a 1793x997 capture (build 2.0.211.59), so Raves' title matches WITHOUT redistributing Qud art. Normalized [x,y,w,h] window fractions. 'menu' = the centred, gilded option box (New Game/Continue/Records/Options/Mods); 'links' = the bottom-left secondary list (Redeem Code/Modding Toolkit/Credits/Help); 'logo' top-centre; 'hint' bottom-centre; 'version' bottom-right. MainMenu.gd reads the runtime copy at ~/Library/Application Support/RavesOfQud/title_layout.json (seeded from this file). Re-measure -> overwrite to re-tune (no rebuild).
